metadata.description: Read pages other fetchers cannot, through Gemini's URL context tool

plugins.name: fetchwright
plugins.description: Read public web pages that refuse scripts (Reddit threads, pages that answer plain HTTP clients with a 403 or a wall) through Gemini's URL context tool: Google reads the page, a standard-library Python CLI checks the retrieval, drops removed-comment placeholders and leaked usernames, and returns the title and text or a thread's post and comments. Never uses Google Search. A setup skill covers the Gemini API key, tiers, quotas and free-tier privacy. Evergreen.
